crons.comment: Hourly; the handler decides whose local reminder time it is.

rewrites.comment: SPA fallback. Without it, refreshing /history or /settings 404s.

headers.comment: Supabase needs connect-src for REST plus wss for realtime. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required by the inline styles the UI sets for per-list accent colours.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

headers.comment: Hashed build assets are content-addressed and safe to cache forever.
The service worker must always be revalidated or updates never ship.
